uncertainties.note: glossary.json locks 'New Federation' (provisional) while character_names_021.json gives 'New United Nations Earth' / 'New UNE'; the file's own rule says glossary.json spelling wins, so New Federation is used. Needs central decision.
Compressed to fit 110: 'an organization called' became 'a body called', 'military power' became 'force of arms'. Who fought the unit is left unstated as in source.
Source omits who is to be taken; 'us' inferred from first-person plural in 1437 and 1439 (speaker evidently Jamil, from 1431).
'spatial transfer device' is a literal rendering of a coloured keyword not found in any glossary/encyclopedia file; proposal filed.

Nadesico wiki spelling 'Chulip' used (wiki wins) although the source word is the ordinary word for tulip and 1448 mocks the name; 'Tulip' would make the remark more transparent. Singular/plural of the Chulip is not marked in source.
One chained monologue (text ids 85-88), probably the 'Tak's monologue' placeholder 1480; speaker not tagged, so 1459 kept subjectless.
Rows 1471-1485 are developer placeholders describing planned voice lines, not dialogue; translated literally. 1481, 1482 and 1485 could also be read as line summaries.
Subject omitted; read as reaction to Unit 2 being spotted in 1492 ('it'). Could equally be addressed to the pilot ('you').
Retort to 1503: 'that is a line for a fully-fledged man' (i.e. the listener is not one yet). Kept close to literal.
Rank rendered 'Major' (Gundam wiki for Gato); contains lowercase j with no natural synonym. 1499 fire-support request kept imperative, no 'me' supplied.

Resources 6041-6043 read like legacy Another Century's Episode 2 mission data (Tak, Burning, Uraki/Gato and Unit 2, Jovian Lizards, UCE) stored among ACE3 tables; translated faithfully without forcing them into the ACE3 Mission 04 storyline.
